[b]EMERGENCY NATIONAL BROADCAST OF THE FRN TO ALL OF TIRAKAN - NRTV-1[/b]
[spoiler]
[i]00:11 / 04 March 2027
Speaker: Arlan Vos, Acting Premier of Naerim
[/i]

[i]All TV and radio programs in Tirakan cut off. Radios give off a static sound, for the TV's a purely black screen, only shining edges of a palace can be seen. The picture flickers twice, due to lightning, then steadies as soon as flood lights turn onto a person. The prime minister. The city behind the glass wall of the broadcast chamber is dark, except for the red reflection of distant fires. Vos stands alone on the pedestal, infront a large door, which seems to be the palace of Dahr-Rav, the Renaissance Union's headquarter of operation.[/i]

People of Naerim...People of Tirakan...the hour has come.

[i]The camera zooms a fraction, to take the fires in the city out the field of vision.[/i]

For four years we have fought on broken land, in mountains and valleys brough down upon us and in the ruins of cities which housed your very own brothers and sisters. For four years we have carried the weight of a nation that refused to die.
Tonight the Renaissance Unions last defensive lines have collapsed.

[i]Theres a long moment of silence. A whole minute, each second seemingly taking longer than its predecessor. And not a single wrinkle on Vos' face, signaling happiness or relief.[/i]

Our eastern divisions forced the pass at Kerrin. The final ridge belt, the one their generals promised could never fall, is burning behind us. Their capital, Dahr-Rav, has been breached by three armored spearheads. The government has abandoned the palace. The streets have fallen silent. Their soldiers are surrendering.
And to our homes south the Holy Leagues final fortifications have broken as well.

[i]A distant flash erupts behind him, dull and red on the horizon, but bright enough to light up the scene for a second. After paying a patient look to the explosion, Arlan Vos turns back to the camera.[/i]

Our Valley Corps pushed through the Serathines. Their capital, Adiysehir, is in open collapse. The temple citadel has been overrun. Their clergy have fled through the mountains, leaving their followers to lay down their swords in confusion and fear. Their radio broadcasts have gone dead.
The north is no longer under their chains.

[i]A tactical map of Marrin, the Coastal Alliance's headquarter and it's advances into Holy League's territory, fades in.
[/i]
And to the west the Coastal Alliance has risen.
Northern Coastal forces storm the last Holy League infrastructure zone at Lakh, in this very moment. The electrical grid is in our allies hands. The waterworks are secure. The Leagues fuel depots have been seized intact. Their militias have scattered.
And in the south, in Marrin where this war began

[i]The picture zooms into Marrin.[/i]

the Alliance has launched a renewed front. Their southern brigades are fighting the Valdderan forces that decided to set foot on Tirakani soil and take hold of a district in Marrin. The defenders of the RU broke within the hour after the majority of Valdderan forces retreated from their positions, and Dahr-Ravs command chain has been cut off by us, and laid down their weapons. The southern coast is rising again.

[i]The picture fades out and Arlan points at Dahr-Rav. He went to the warzone himself, as a sign of triumph, but also respect.
[/i]

People of Naerim we have crossed the threshold. The Renaissance Union is finished. The Holy League is collapsing in every direction. And the Valdderan presence on Tirakan soil is breaking.
But this is not victory. Not yet.

[i]He turns back to the camera, face illuminated on one side only, creating an eerie look.[/i]

What lies ahead is the hour history warns us about: the hour when we forget our duty. When we let down our guard. When we allow foreign powers to take hold of what is ours once more.

[i]He blankly stares into the camera for a few seconds.
[/i]
The scale has tipped. For too long we have talked about Naerim rising again.
Our forces advance through ruins booby-trapped with explosives. The mountains are unsafe. The valleys traffic is choked through collapsed roads. Our pilots fight through skies filled with hidden anti-air batteries. Two of our jets have not returned. Their presence still lingers over the halls, we have thought to cleansed from their corruption. So do not mistake celebration for peace. As right now, we are just beginning.

[i]Another long pause, breaks his speech.[/i]

We will pay blood with blood. King Al-Tiran. If you see this, know. Know that we see you in this very moment. Know that we are merely sparing you, for you to watch as we crush what you have built up. And then we will come and get you. Count your days.

We used to say 'A morgna wes core'. The morning will come. But mistake not. A morgna her coren. The morning has come.

[b][i]The broadcast end apruptly. Citizen all over the country, in Dahr-Rav, Naerim-City, Marrin, and even all the little towns near Adiysehir, cheer. The war seems to have taken an end.[/i][/b]
